description: Vehicles: prepare (unsigned) the purchase of a GROUND vehicle (model 1 Sentinel, 2 Hauler, 3 Courier) for ZENI: an approve for the exact price, then buy. Needs the public sale open (see vehicle_shop). The aircraft (4 Helicopter, 5 Private jet) are sold for ETH: use prepare_vehicle_buy_eth. A Sentinel or Courier can race in the Night Run; the Hauler cannot race but carries the most cargo and armour on convoy hits and Ledger jobs. There are no licences: anyone can buy and use any vehicle at once.

model.description: 1 to 3 for ZENI (4 and 5 are sold for ETH).

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_vehicle_buy
